description: Send a document for signature using exactly one source. from_pdf uploads new PDF bytes, waits for processing and creates or reuses email signers. from_document uses an existing document_id and signer IDs; inspect the document first and do not repeat an existing assignment. from_template generates a document and assignment from a saved template; discover roles and field IDs first. These actions send invitations and can consume credits: use recipients authorized by the user. After a partial failure, inspect the retained document ID and continue from_document instead of uploading again.

oneOf.description: New PDF: provide file_name, file_base64 and signers by full_name/email. Creates a virtual assignment with Email verification and notification.

account_id.description: account ID; uses the request or server default if omitted

expires_at.description: assignment expiry timestamp in RFC 3339 format

max_wait_secs.description: maximum seconds to wait for PDF processing (default 30; max 600)

poll_secs.description: polling interval in seconds (default 2; cannot exceed max_wait_secs)

signers.description: one or more signers to create or reuse and request signatures from

email.description: signer's email address; existing exact matches are reused

oneOf.description:
Request signatures on a document. Use `method: virtual` to sign without input fields, or `method: collect` to place input fields on specific pages.

For **virtual**, the document may be in `uploaded`, `metadata_processing` or `metadata_ready`; it is promoted to `pending_signature` automatically once metadata processing completes. For **collect**, the document must be in `metadata_ready` (fields reference specific pages).

`step` controls signing order: signers sharing a step sign in parallel, and the next step is notified only after the previous step completes. If supplied, every signer must supply it and values must be contiguous starting at 1. Obtain signer IDs from find_signers/save_signer and page IDs from find_documents action get. This sends signing invitations.

copy_receivers.description: Signer IDs that only receive a copy.

entries.description: Required for `collect`: field placements per page.

display_settings.description: A field placement rectangle on a document page. Geometry values are pixels in Assinafy's 150-DPI page image, measured from the upper-left corner. Clients must keep the rectangle within the selected page's width and height; the API does not clamp out-of-bounds values.

fontSize.description: Font size in the 150-DPI page-image coordinate system.

height.description: Height of the placement rectangle, in page-image pixels.

left.description: Horizontal distance from the page's left edge, in page-image pixels.

top.description: Vertical distance from the page's top edge, in page-image pixels.

width.description: Width of the placement rectangle, in page-image pixels.

message.description: Text included in the invitation email.

notification_methods.description: Channels used to notify the signer of the request. Any combination of `Email` and `Whatsapp` (WhatsApp incurs an additional cost and is available only on paid subscriptions). Omit to default to `{"Email"}`.

verification_method.description: How the signer's identity is verified before signing. `Email` (default) sends a one-time code to the signer's email; `Whatsapp` sends the code over WhatsApp — the verification itself is not billed, but it requires the WhatsApp notification channel, so the signer costs 0.45 credits (available only on paid subscriptions); `DigitalCertificate` has the signer sign with their own ICP-Brasil certificate (A1/A3) — it requires the Digital Certificate feature, the signer must have a CPF or CNPJ in `government_id`, must be alone in its signing step, and is charged 2 credits per signer. A CPF requires that person's certificate (an e-CPF, or an e-CNPJ naming them as legal representative); a CNPJ requires an e-CNPJ for that company, from any of its representatives. Omit to default to `Email`.

oneOf.description: Saved template: provide template_id and one signer per role, by id or full_name/email. Use field_id/string-value pairs in editor_fields, after check_fields validation.

account_id.description: account ID; uses request routing if omitted

value.description: value to bake into the generated document

signers.description: one signer per template role, each by ID or by name and email

email.description: signer's email address, required when id is omitted; existing exact matches are reused

full_name.description: signer's full name; required when id is omitted

id.description: existing signer ID; use instead of full_name and email

notification_methods.description: at most one channel: Email or Whatsapp; inferred from verification_method when omitted

step.description: signing order, contiguous from 1; all signers must set it if any does

tags.description: tag names, merged with the template's defaults

action.description: Choose exactly one action; supply only its arguments.
